question: Where’s the closest gallery along the path to Candlestick Park, Four Oaks, NC starting at Aquarium Outfitters Carolina, Wake Forest, NC?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Aquarium Outfitters Carolina%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wake Forest%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Candlestick Park%' LIMIT 1 ), path_corridor AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(sp.geometry, ep.geometry)::geography, 500) AS buffered_path FROM start_point sp, end_point ep ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, path_corridor pc WHERE p.tourism = 'gallery' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, pc.buffered_path) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM start_point)::geography) LIMIT 1;
